title: Lytherium
description: Server with PvP Practice 1vs1, Simple Vanilla (economy and protections), and OP Vanilla (clans). Small Spanish-speaking community open to all players.
body:
Lytherium
Welcome to Lytherium, a community primarily focused on Spanish-speaking players, though everyone is welcome. We offer a stable and diverse experience for different playstyles.

Available Modes
PvP Practice 1vs1: A dedicated space to sharpen your combat skills in direct duels.

Simple Vanilla: Technical survival that preserves the game's core essence, featuring only economy and land protections.

OP Vanilla: An intensified mode including a clan system and power weapons for a more aggressive playstyle.

In Development
We are currently working on implementing an Anarchy mode.

Join our small community and enjoy an environment designed for everyone's fun.
